mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Sport P510e engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete rebuilt Range Rover Sport P510e engine typically costs between £6,500 and £9,500 for supply only [ESTIMATED - using 306PS 3.0 Ingenium Petrol as proxy]. Used units start from around £2,500. Reconditioned units range from £4,500 to £7,500. Prices vary based on the specific AJ300E engine code and supplier.

mainEntity.name: Can the Range Rover Sport P510e run on just the petrol engine if the hybrid system fails?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Range Rover Sport P510e is designed to default to the 3.0L petrol engine if the high-voltage battery or electric drive unit fails. The vehicle will enter a reduced-power "limp mode" to protect the drivetrain. Fuel economy will drop significantly as the heavy battery is carried without electric assistance. A full diagnostic is required to isolate whether the fault lies with the combustion engine or the hybrid components.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of thermal management failure in a Range Rover Sport P510e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include a sudden reduction in electric-only driving range or slower-than-normal AC charging speeds. Dashboard warnings for "High Voltage System Fault" or "Engine Cooling System". The vehicle may refuse to accept a charge or abruptly switch to petrol-only mode. Unusual humming or whining from the rear electric drive unit.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Sport P510e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. The Range Rover Sport P510e is a high-value luxury SUV with current market values ranging from £65,000 to over £95,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. A rebuilt engine cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's total value. It preserves the car's performance, refinement, and resale value. Upgraded rebuilt units address known factory thermal and integration weaknesses.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Sport P510e engine supply and fit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional Range Rover Sport P510e engine replacement typically takes 4 to 6 working days due to the complexity of the hybrid system. Removal and preparation of the old unit takes 1-2 days. Fitting, high-voltage system calibration, and software integration of the new rebuilt engine takes 2-4 days. Nationwide collection and delivery are arranged by the specialist.

commonProblems.h3: The 3.0L Ingenium straight-six plug-in hybrid in the Range Rover Sport P510e is a highly advanced powertrain. While offering exceptional efficiency and torque, its complex thermal management and high-voltage architecture require precise, specialist maintenance. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.group: Thermal Management & High-Voltage Battery Cooling Issues
problems.h4: Thermal Management & High-Voltage Battery Cooling Issues - Why the Range Rover Sport P510e AJ300E Requires Attention
problems.typicalFailureMileage: 40,000-80,000 miles (emerging pattern in early L461 models)
problems.rootCause: The complex thermal management system, which cools both the combustion engine and the high-voltage battery pack, can develop pump or sensor faults. This leads to reduced charging speeds, limp mode activation, or restricted electric-only range to protect the battery from overheating.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Coolant flush, pump inspection, and software updates for thermal management
repairOptions.longevity: Highly suitable for early warning signs before component failure

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt 3.0L PHEV with updated cooling components and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if thermal failure has caused secondary damage to the combustion engine block

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Range Rover Sport P510e holds a current UK market value of £65,000-£95,000+ depending on specification and mileage [THIRD-PARTY]. At this valuation, a rebuilt engine replacement cost represents a small fraction of the vehicle's total value, making professional replacement highly viable to preserve its premium status.
problems.recommendation: Proactive inspection of the thermal management system at the first sign of charging slowdowns or warning lights is a highly recommended, low-cost preventative measure. If the combustion engine has suffered secondary damage from overheating, a full rebuilt engine replacement is the safest and most reliable solution.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt AJ300E Range Rover Sport P510e engine prices

problems.group: Electric Drive Unit Bearing Wear & Software Glitches
problems.h4: Electric Drive Unit Bearing Wear & Software Glitches - Range Rover Sport P510E Performance Vulnerability
problems.rootCause: The rear-mounted electric drive unit can develop bearing wear over time, manifesting as a high-pitched whine. Additionally, software integration glitches between the combustion engine and electric motor can cause abrupt drive mode transitions or false fault codes.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Diagnostic scan, latest ECU/inverter software flash, and bearing noise assessment
repairOptions.longevity: Viable for software glitches and early-stage bearing noise

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt engine with verified electric drive unit integration and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the electric drive unit has seized or caused catastrophic drivetrain damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Given the £65,000-£95,000+ value band of the Range Rover Sport P510e, addressing software or early bearing issues is trivial compared to the vehicle's worth. Ignoring them risks catastrophic failure, making a rebuilt engine the necessary fallback if the drivetrain is compromised.
problems.recommendation: If caught early, a specialist software update and drive unit inspection is the most cost-effective route. However, if the electric drive unit has seized or caused catastrophic failure, investing in a fully rebuilt unit with verified hybrid integration is the only way to guarantee long-term reliability.
